name: Tailwind CSS v4 default theme + Catalyst UI kit (Tailwind Plus)
licence: Tailwind CSS framework and theme.css: MIT (npm tailwindcss@4.3.3). Catalyst and Tailwind Plus blocks: commercial, paid (Tailwind Plus $299 individual / $979 team one-time, Catalyst standalone $149 per checkout page seen in search). Full licence text sits behind the Tailwind Plus login and was NOT read; do not copy Catalyst source into the engine.
bestFor: SaaS application UI (dashboards, settings, tables, auth)
a neutral zinc base that any brand accent can sit on
teams that want Tailwind's default theme as the design system with no extra token layer
avoidFor: brand-led marketing heroes that need a voice (Catalyst ships no marketing components)
projects that heavily customise the Tailwind default theme (docs warn components assume the defaults)
anything that must be open-source redistributed (paid licence)

families: Tailwind v4.3.3 --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif + emoji
--font-serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif
--font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
typography.notes: Tracking tokens: tighter -0.05em, tight -0.025em, normal 0, wide 0.025em, wider 0.05em, widest 0.1em. Leading tokens: tight 1.25, snug 1.375, normal 1.5, relaxed 1.625, loose 2. Sizes >=48px ship line-height 1. Catalyst's signature move: controls and text are 16px on touch and step DOWN to 14px at sm (640px), so mobile inputs never trigger iOS zoom and desktop stays dense; line-height stays 24px so rhythm holds. Page headings are deliberately small (20px desktop): app UI, not marketing.

accents.Catalyst button colours: dark/zinc (default), light, dark/white, white, zinc + 17 hues (indigo..rose)

semantic.Catalyst control border: zinc-950/10, hover zinc-950/20 (dark white/10, hover white/20)
semantic.note: No success/warning/info tokens: Catalyst picks palette hues per component.

color.darkMode: Per-utility dark: variant (no semantic token layer). Catalyst dark surfaces use white at low alpha (bg white/5, border white/10, white/15) over zinc-900/950 rather than a separate dark palette.
color.contrastNotes: zinc-500 on white is used for secondary text; Catalyst's adaptive button colours (dark/zinc, light, dark/white) flip per mode to keep contrast. Coloured buttons use dark text on light hues (amber-400 bg + amber-950 text; cyan-300 + cyan-950; lime-300 + lime-950), i.e. contrast is solved per hue, not by always using white text.

spacing.base: 4px (--spacing: 0.25rem; any integer or .5 multiple is a utility)

radius.rule: Catalyst uses radius-lg (8px) for buttons, inputs, selects; inner layers use calc(var(--radius-lg) - 1px) so nested shapes stay concentric; rounded-xl (12px) for dropdown items/menus, rounded-2xl for dialogs (from class conventions; dialog value inferred, not measured); rounded-full only for switch/avatar.

shadows: Catalyst solid button: before:shadow-sm + after:shadow-[inset_0_1px_white/15%] (top highlight)
Catalyst input: before:bg-white before:shadow-sm, light mode only
depth.borders: 1px; colour as alpha of the text colour (zinc-950/10, white/10), never a fixed grey. Solid button border = a darker step of its own fill at 80-90% alpha.

motion.notes: Catalyst switch: transition duration-0, only data-changing:duration-200 (moves only when state changes, never on mount). Catalyst depends on the 'motion' package for layout transitions (navbar/sidebar indicator); exact values not public.

modes: Table: default / dense / grid / striped / bleed props

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: High for app controls: data-hover, data-focus (keyboard only, via Headless UI), data-active, data-disabled, data-invalid, data-checked, data-changing, forced-colors variants, dark variants on every control. No loading state on Button.

tokenArchitecture: Single layer: Tailwind @theme primitives (--color-zinc-500, --spacing, --radius-lg, --shadow-sm) used directly in utilities. Catalyst adds component-local CSS variables (--btn-bg, --btn-border, --btn-icon, --btn-hover-overlay, --switch-bg) set per colour variant, so one structural class string serves 20+ colours. No semantic (primary/background) layer.
distinctiveness: Layered-pseudo-element controls: border as a darker fill underneath, before: for the fill + shadow, after: for the 1px white inner top highlight and the hover overlay. Gives a tactile, physical button with no gradients. Touch-first sizes that tighten at 640px.
weaknesses: No semantic tokens: rebranding means editing component files
No marketing/brand components; Tailwind Plus blocks cover that but are generic and widely used, so they read as 'Tailwind template'
Paid licence, source not inspectable publicly
Default theme's system font stack + zinc is the most common SaaS look on the web; using it unmodified gives zero identity
takeaways: Size controls at 44px on touch and 36px at >=640px with the same 24px line-height; one class string, two densities.
Express borders as alpha of the foreground (zinc-950/10) so they work on any surface.
Give nested layers radius = outer - 1px to stay concentric.
Show focus only for keyboard (data-focus) with a 2px offset outline in one blue; hide on mouse.
Per-variant CSS variables (--btn-bg/--btn-border) let one component carry many colours without class explosion.
provenance: mixed (theme.css from npm tailwindcss@4.3.3 = public-spec; Catalyst values measured from rendered class strings on public docs pages)
